data.name: ImageHelpText
data.value:
The selected image appears only on the current Windows primary display. Other extended displays stay black.
Choose a JPG, PNG or BMP file (up to 32 MB and 40 million pixels). Choosing a file applies it immediately. Fill may crop the image edges.
Use primary image adopts what is currently on the primary display. Undo image restores one previous image until the app exits, without undoing other settings.
The image is shared across Virtual Desktops. Spotlight and slideshow are not supported.

data.name: StartupHint
data.value:
Starts this app after you sign in to Windows, for this user account.
Changing this switch takes effect immediately. Keep the program in its chosen location. If you move it, turn this setting off and on again from the new location.

data.name: ChooseImageFirst
data.value: Choose a picture or use the current primary image to start.
